ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with discrete high-intensity (white) pixel clusters occupying approximately 8-12% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous field across both lobes; high-intensity white circular clusters concentrated at distal tips; diffuse white mottling visible at the mid-left periphery and lower-central region near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped vertex; depth-to-width ratio approximately 1:1.5; internal pixel angle approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular saw-tooth profile along the trailing boundary; high-frequency peaks and valleys; distinct irregular indentation/missing section on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes with lateral tips oriented dorsally; significant geometric asymmetry present in the right lobe profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacles); primary concentrations at distal tips and sparsely scattered along the trailing edges and mid-section of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear pixel segments; three prominent parallel lines on the left lobe surface; several shorter lines visible on the central-lower surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular excision on right lobe trailing edge; heavy accumulation of protruding high-intensity biological mass (barnacle clusters) at both distal tips.
